concept.card: Duration neglect describes evaluations that give an experience’s length little weight even when its duration is known. concept.learning_takeaway: Remembered evaluations of brief experiences can give duration little weight even when duration is known.

relations.note: The study’s remembered-experience evaluations establish the factual memory connection; memory is an editorial parent.
